trap.label: Not only + inversão
trap.wrong: Not only we cut prices, but also we grew.
trap.right: Not only did we cut prices, but we also grew.
trap.why: Em português “não só… mas também” não inverte. Em inglês, Not only no início pede auxiliar antes do sujeito.

mcq.q: Not only ___ we cut prices, but we also grew.
In a report, “by and large” means…

fix.wrong: Seldom I have seen such growth.
fix.right: Seldom have I seen such growth.

fix.wrong: Not only we cut costs, but also we grew.
fix.right: Not only did we cut costs, but we also grew.

fix.wrong: For the most part he sell shares.
fix.right: For the most part, he sold shares.
